caseNameFull: Ryan v. Alexander, Formerly Collector of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. Chas. H. Garnett for petitioner. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. Sewall Key and William L. Cary for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
